name: Artisan Forest Honey
description: Raw, unfiltered wildflower honey gathered from high-meadow hives.
story: Hand-extracted from wild hives in the Oakridge Forest perimeter, cold-filtered to preserve active enzymes and floral notes, then sealed in amber glass with zero closure. Quality-verified by the Northern Highlands Apicultural Guild.

name: Hand-Pressed Cold Olive Oil
description: First cold-pressed extra-virgin olive oil from heritage groves.
story: Olives are picked by hand and pressed within four hours of harvest under the heritage hammer, where the fruit is crushed between cool stone wheels within hours of leaving the branch — preserving polyphenols and a peppery finish.

name: Oceanic Swirl Serving Bowl
description: Hand-thrown stoneware bowl with a coastal swirl glaze.
story: Thrown on the wheel and glazed with a coastal swirl drawn from saltmarsh blues, each bowl is one of a kind and food-safe.

name: Miniature Earth Cup Set
description: A set of four earthy hand-pinched cups.
story: Pinched by hand from local clay and fired with an ash glaze that pools into warm, earthy tones.

name: Wabi-Sabi Charcoal Vase
description: Matte charcoal bud vase with a wabi-sabi silhouette.
story: An intentionally imperfect form, glazed in matte charcoal — a quiet study in wabi-sabi for a single stem.

name: Hand-Woven Linen Set
story: Woven on a floor loom and dyed with plant pigments — flax to fibre, fully traceable.

name: Stoneware Milk Pitcher
story: Wheel-thrown and glazed in a soft cream that pairs with any table.

name: Sun-Dried Heritage Ghee
description: Slow-cooked cultured ghee from grass-fed herds.
story: Cultured and slow-cooked in copper from the milk of grass-fed herds, hand-skimmed for a nutty, golden finish.

name: High-Altitude Arabica Beans
description: Shade-grown, hand-picked arabica from high terraces.
story: Grown on shaded high terraces and hand-picked at peak ripeness, then sun-dried on raised beds.

name: Linen Table Runner
description: A naturally dyed linen runner for the heritage table.
story: Hand-woven and finished with a hand-rolled hem; a quiet centrepiece in undyed flax.
